overview: The committee authorized $190,000 for urgent network infrastructure repairs and received presentations on the new Adaptive Physical Education program and English Learner department initiatives. It also approved a revised school calendar to correct a day-count error.

items.title: EL Department Update
items.summary: Director Paul Teixeira reported on summer programming success and the district's ongoing partnership with Lesley University for teacher certification.

items.title: Adaptive Physical Education Report
items.summary: Carla Andre outlined the new APE program's implementation, detailing how eligibility is determined and how the program supplements general physical education inclusion.

items.title: Opening of School Report
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Edouard-Vincent introduced new district administrators and acknowledged substantial donations of school supplies from local businesses.

items.title: Virtual Network Infrastructure Funding
items.summary: Approved the expenditure of up to $190,000 to replace aging storage hardware critical to the district's virtual network.

items.title: Human Capital Report
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy presented a new template for monthly personnel reporting to track district appointments, promotions, and retirements.

items.title: Public Comment on Crossing Guards
items.summary: A resident's letter requested a permanent crossing guard at Riverside Avenue and Freedom Way following the cancellation of a school bus route.

items.title: Revised 2021-2022 School Calendar
items.summary: Approved a revised calendar to correct an extra-day calculation error and move a half-day release to avoid a conflict with MCAS testing.
